dish.title: Paneer Tikka with Peppers and Onions, Mint Chutney, and Naan
dish.description: Cubes of paneer marinated in thick yogurt, ginger, garlic, Kashmiri chili, garam masala, and lemon, threaded with bell peppers and red onion, and charred under the broiler. Served with a fresh mint-cilantro yogurt chutney, warm naan, and a kachumber salad.

recipe_version.title: Paneer Tikka with Peppers and Onions, Mint Chutney, and Naan
recipe_version.description: Cubes of paneer marinated in thick yogurt, ginger, garlic, Kashmiri chili, garam masala, and lemon, threaded with bell peppers and red onion, and charred under the broiler. Served with a fresh mint-cilantro yogurt chutney, warm naan, and a kachumber salad.

ingredients.name: paneer
ingredients.display_name: paneer whose label lists milk and an acid only (no rennet)

ingredients.name: plain whole-milk Greek yogurt
ingredients.display_name: plain whole-milk Greek yogurt whose label lists milk and cultures only

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.note: juice of 1 1/2 for marinade, chutney, and salad; the rest in wedges

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/4 tsp marinade, 1/4 tsp chutney, 1/2 tsp salad

ingredients.name: red onions
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 in squares for skewers, 1/2 chopped for the salad

ingredients.name: naan
ingredients.display_name: plain naan whose label lists wheat flour, milk or yogurt, oil, and leavening, with no egg, soy, or sesame

steps.title: Marinate the paneer
steps.body: Juice the lemons, keeping a few wedges. Whisk 2/3 cup yogurt, the ginger, garlic, Kashmiri chili, garam masala, cumin, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 1/4 tsp salt, and the oil. Fold in the paneer cubes, peppers, and the squared onion.

steps.title: Make the chutney and salad
steps.body: While the paneer marinates, blend the mint, cilantro, chile, 1/3 cup yogurt, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and 1/4 tsp salt until smooth. Toss the cucumber, tomatoes, chopped onion, the remaining lemon juice, and 1/2 tsp salt (overlap stated).

steps.title: Preheat the broiler and skewer
steps.body: Preheat the broiler on high for 5 minutes with a rack 6 inches below the element. Meanwhile thread the paneer, peppers, and onion alternately onto 8 skewers and lay them on a wire rack over a foil-lined sheet pan.

steps.title: Broil
steps.body: Broil, turning once, until the paneer and vegetables are charred in spots, about 5 minutes per side. Warm the naan on the lower oven rack during the last 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the skewers with the naan, a bowl of mint chutney, the kachumber, and lemon wedges.

equipment: rimmed sheet pan with a wire rack
blender or mortar for the chutney
